tips.text: Shoot all 16 nodes on the core before the core itself; each one raises the damage you deal.
Run it in a public squad; pubs routinely clear the 1,000,000 milestone on the first run.
Wait until the whole squad is inside before triggering the Disruptor; an early trigger burns everyone's Disruptor and cannot be undone.
Count the 1,000,000 damage in one run: it is a squad total that does not add up across runs.
Mod your archgun for raw damage, multishot and fire rate, since the core takes no critical hits.
Keep running after the 1,000,000 milestone; the parts drop whether or not you hit it.
Cast your Archwing buffs before crossing 1,400m from the core; abilities switch off inside but active buffs persist.
Hug one side of the map on the approach and shoot Zeplens before they net you.
Ask a clanmate for a spare part during the event; parts and the blueprint trade.
Buy the Disruptor blueprint now and build several before the event starts.
Check the World State for the event instead of trusting the construction meter; activation is manual and can lag for weeks.
Join in the first days; the event ends as soon as the Fomorian's health pool empties, not only when the timer runs out.
Run Excavation on the attacked planet; it farms Cryotic and Omega Isotopes together.
Bring Nekros Desecrate or a pilfer-augment frame and kill Bombards for the isotope farm; heavies drop several.
Expect a short mission and a long wait: the farm is easy and the only real cost is the event window.
